common.tagline: A clearer path to specialist care
common.emergency: Emergency symptoms? RehletShifaa is not an emergency service. Call your local emergency number or seek urgent care now.
common.medicalNotice: RehletShifaa coordinates access to medical review and care. Information provided through the platform does not replace emergency care or a complete clinical assessment. Final medical decisions are made by the treating consultant following appropriate evaluation.

home.eyebrow: Care in Egypt, coordinated for international patients
home.title: Understand your treatment options before you travel
home.intro: Send the medical information you already have. We prepare your case for a Consultant in the right specialty, then explain what they recommend, what it is likely to cost, and what would happen next.
assurances: A Consultant reviews your case before you decide anything
Reports are uploaded through private, short-lived links
One bilingual coordinator, from your first message onwards
home.preliminaryNotice: Recommendations and cost estimates are preliminary and can change after an in-person assessment.
home.heroCardTitle: You can start with what you already have
prepareItems: A recent medical report or discharge summary
A short note about your concern
home.heroCardNote: If anything else is needed, your coordinator will tell you before the review.

video.title: See what happens after you start
video.intro: Discover how RehletShifaa turns your medical reports into a consultant-led care journey, with one dedicated coordinator guiding every step from review to treatment and follow-up.

steps.title: Share what you have
steps.body: A report, any tests, and a short note. A complete file is not required.

steps.title: Your coordinator reviews it
steps.body: One person checks what you sent and tells you if anything is missing.

steps.title: A Consultant assesses your case
steps.body: We route it by clinical need, so you do not have to choose a specialty.

steps.title: You decide what happens next
steps.body: You will know the recommendation, the likely cost and the practical steps first.

areas.title: Cardiology
areas.body: Coronary, structural heart and rhythm care, from angiography and stents to valve and device procedures.

areas.title: Rehabilitation, Dysphagia & Physical Medicine
areas.body: Adult and pediatric swallowing rehabilitation, a service few centres offer, with physical medicine and rheumatology.

areas.title: Orthopedics
areas.body: Joint replacement, sports injuries, arthroscopy, and spine and trauma assessment, including a second opinion before surgery.

home.howTitle: What happens after you send your case
home.howIntro: Four steps. Someone is responsible at each one.
home.coordinatorBody: Your Patient Coordinator stays connected with you from your first contact through treatment coordination and follow-up.
home.beforeTitle: Understand Your Care Path Before You Travel
home.beforeBody: Where medically possible, RehletShifaa helps you understand the proposed next steps and expected arrangements before deciding to travel.
home.trustIntro: Coordinating care means handling sensitive medical information. These are the rules we work to.

trust.title: Consultants make clinical decisions
trust.body: We coordinate your case. Diagnosis, procedure choice and suitability stay with the treating Consultant.

trust.title: Private document handling
trust.body: Reports go straight to private storage through short-lived links. Nothing is published or listed publicly.

trust.title: Your consent comes first
trust.body: Your case is reviewed only after you allow your information to be used for coordinating your care.

trust.title: Emergency care comes first
trust.body: If your situation looks urgent, we will tell you to seek care where you are rather than wait to travel.

home.finalBody: Send what you already have. We will arrange the right review and stay with you through the next step.
home.finalNote: Starting a case does not commit you to treatment or travel.
home.slogan: You see the full picture first. The decision stays yours.
home.areasIntro: Start with the area closest to your need. If you are not sure, send your case and your coordinator will direct it.

consultantsPromise.title: Senior Consultants. Clear clinical responsibility.
consultantsPromise.body: Your case is reviewed by a Consultant chosen for the clinical experience it calls for. That Consultant carries the decision, and you will know who they are.

travel.title: Travel support built around your care
travel.intro: If you choose to continue your care in Egypt, our team can arrange the practical parts of the trip. It is optional, and it comes after the medical plan.

items.title: Flights
items.body: Booking arranged around your treatment dates.

items.title: Accommodation
items.body: A stay for you and a companion, chosen for comfort and access.

items.title: Visa support
items.body: Guidance and documents for a medical visa.

items.title: Airport transfer
items.body: Someone meets you when you land and takes you where you need to be.

travel.note: Arranged after your medical proposal, and only if you want it.
travel.packageLabel: Arranged by our own team, not outsourced

footer.description: Consultant-led coordination of international cardiac care in Egypt, in Arabic and English.

cardiology.title: Advanced Cardiac Care, Guided by Your Case
cardiology.intro: You don't need to choose a cardiac specialty yourself. Send your medical information and RehletShifaa will help direct your case to the appropriate consultant.
coronaryItems: Evaluation for alternative treatment when PCI is not appropriate
coronaryExamples: Coronary artery narrowing or blockage was diagnosed
Coronary disease was described as complex
Another opinion is required before intervention
cardiology.suitability: Suitability for any procedure is determined only after consultant review.
rhythmExamples: A second opinion is needed before device implantation
cardiology.finalTitle: Not Sure Where Your Condition Fits?
cardiology.finalBody: That's completely fine. You do not need to select a specialty. Send your reports and we'll help direct your case to the appropriate consultant.

consultants.title: Experienced Cardiac Consultants
consultants.intro: Your case is directed to the consultant whose area of expertise is most appropriate for the medical information provided.
consultants.notice: Development profiles — names and credentials below are clearly marked placeholders and must be replaced with verified consultant data before publication.
consultants.finalTitle: You Don't Need to Choose a Consultant
consultants.finalBody: Not sure which consultant is right for your condition? Send your case and RehletShifaa will help direct it to the appropriate consultant.

how.title: Your Care Journey, Clearly Coordinated
how.intro: From your first medical reports to treatment coordination, RehletShifaa helps make the process simpler.

steps.title: Send Your Case
steps.body: Send the medical reports and investigations already available.

steps.title: Patient Coordinator
steps.body: Your dedicated coordinator organizes your information and helps identify missing documents.

steps.title: Consultant Review
steps.body: Your case is directed to the appropriate consultant.

steps.title: Understand Your Care Path
steps.body: Recommendations may include further investigation, medical treatment, a procedure or intervention, surgical evaluation, rehabilitation, or another appropriate pathway.

steps.title: Treatment Coordination
steps.body: If you decide to proceed in Egypt, RehletShifaa coordinates the required next steps.

steps.title: Treatment & Follow-Up
steps.body: Coordination continues through treatment and follow-up according to consultant recommendations.

rheumatology.title: Dysphagia Rehabilitation & Physical Medicine
rheumatology.intro: A rare, focused service for adults and children with swallowing (dysphagia) difficulties — alongside broader rehabilitation, physical medicine and rheumatology. Send your reports and RehletShifaa will help direct your case to the appropriate consultant.
rheumatology.highlight: A rare, specialised service — Adult & Pediatric Dysphagia (swallowing) Rehabilitation.
rheumatology.videoTitle: Meet your rehabilitation & dysphagia consultant — coming soon
rheumatology.note: Your treatment and therapy plan is decided by the consultant after review. RehletShifaa coordinates the case; it does not diagnose or prescribe.
